Date : 09.05.2025 Heard Mr. J. Sarmah, learned counsel for the petitioner; Mr. S.S. Roy, learned CGC for the respondent no. 1; and Ms. M. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 2 & 5.
2.

The petitioner has claimed that he is the land owner of two plots of land measuring 1 Bigha 1 Katha, covered by Dag no. 296 F.C. Grant Patta no. 1 [subject-plot no. 1] and 2 Bighas 10 Lessas,
covered by Dag no. 375 and F.S. Grant Patta no. 1 [subject-plot no. 2] at Panikhaiti Revenue Village,
Mouza - Beltola, District - Kamrup [M].

The petitioner was served two notices under Section 3[1] of the Petroleum and Mineral Pipeline [Acquisition of Right of User in Land] Act, 1962 whereby, the petitioner was informed that the respondent no. 4 would acquire the Right of User for the scheduled plots of lands, which are parts of the subject-lands, mentioned in the notices, all dated 04.08.2020.
3.

sentences.text: The petitioner has stated that though the respondent authorities in the Page No.# 3/3 IGGL have acquired the Right of User by taking over the possession of the scheduled plots of lands, mentioned in the notices, as far back as in the year 2021, no compensation has been paid to the petitioner till date.

As Mr. Roy, learned CGC has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1 and Ms. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 2 & 5, issuance of formal notices to the said Sri Sunil Biswas vs The Union Of India And 4 Ors on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47789105/
